info.title: ADEPT Agentic Framework API
info.description: Unified API for the ADEPT Agentic Framework supporting OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Response API, Knowledge Bases, and MCP protocol. This framework provides a production-ready, three-tier secure architecture with Keycloak authentication, PostgreSQL-backed persistence, and multi-agent orchestration capabilities.
